item.description: After a record-setting and difficult deployment to the Middle East, the USS Abraham Lincoln, carrying some 5,000 service members, will finally arrive home. The aircraft carrier that was plagued by supply shortages and low morale during its nearly year-long assignment, is scheduled to dock in San Diego on Thursday, setting the scene for emotional family reunions. NBC’s Courtney Kube reports for TODAY from aboard the Lincoln.

item.description: Death row inmate Christa Pike’s attorneys are shedding new light on her ongoing health struggles following the failed execution. “She has pneumonia. She is not able to swallow yet, so she has not eaten,” her attorney said, adding about her mental state, “She is angry and confused about everything right now.” Meanwhile, her legal team is renewing calls for the governor to commute her death sentence. NBC’s Aaron Gilchrist reports for TODAY.
